name: MonarchAiConfidenceMeter
title: AiConfidenceMeter
summary: How sure the AI is about a value, as low, medium or high, always in words, in a compact badge or a labelled bar.
whenToUse: Next to a value the AI extracted or suggested, so people know which ones to check.
whenNotToUse: For progress of a task use MonarchProgress. For marking content as AI-written use MonarchAiGeneratedBadge.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiConfidenceMeter(value: Float, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchAiConfidenceMeterVariant = MonarchAiConfidenceMeterVariant.Badge, size: MonarchAiConfidenceMeterSize = MonarchAiConfidenceMeterSize.Md, explanation: String? = null, lowThreshold: Float = 0.6f, highThreshold: Float = 0.85f, showValue: Boolean? = null, icon: (@Composable (MonarchAiConfidenceLevel) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiConfidenceMeterLabels = MonarchAiConfidenceMeterLabels())

enum class MonarchAiConfidenceLevel { Low, Medium, High; companion object { const val DEFAULT_LOW_THRESHOLD: Float; const val DEFAULT_HIGH_THRESHOLD: Float; fun of(value: Float, lowThreshold: Float = 0.6f, highThreshold: Float = 0.85f): MonarchAiConfidenceLevel } }
class MonarchAiConfidenceMeterLabels(low: String? = null, medium: String? = null, high: String? = null, meter: String? = null, valueText: ((label: String, percent: String) -> String)? = null)

options.name: value
options.description: The confidence from 0 to 1. Values outside the range are clamped; not-a-number counts as 0.

options.name: variant
options.description: A compact badge, or a labelled bar.

options.name: size
options.description: Sm has tighter padding, a thinner track and caption text in the bar.

options.name: explanation
options.description: Why the model is or is not confident. Shown under the bar; for the badge it is read by TalkBack after the value.

options.name: lowThreshold
options.description: The edge under which confidence is low.

options.name: highThreshold
options.description: The edge from which confidence is high.

options.name: showValue
options.description: Whether the percentage is shown. By default only the bar shows it.

options.name: icon
options.description: An icon before the band label. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the band labels, the bar name and the spoken value.

states.name: low
states.description: "Needs check" in the low-confidence color on a danger-subtle capsule; the bar fill in the low-confidence color.

states.name: medium
states.description: "Medium confidence" in the medium-confidence color on a warning-subtle capsule.

states.name: high
states.description: "High confidence" in the high-confidence color on a success-subtle capsule.

appearance: The badge is a capsule with the subtle fill and border of the danger, warning or success role and the confidence role of the band for the icon and label; the percentage is in muted text. The bar is a muted track filled with the confidence role of the band, with the label above and the explanation in muted text below.
platformNotes: The web shows the badge's explanation in a tooltip on hover and focus; touch has no tooltip, so for the badge the explanation is only read by TalkBack. Use the bar when sighted people must read it. The web draws its own band glyphs; Monarch for Android bundles no icons, so the icon is a slot and the band is always in words. The web's small badge uses an 11px size; Android uses the caption role at both sizes and tightens the padding, as iOS does. The web's aiConfidenceLevel function is MonarchAiConfidenceLevel.of. Built-in strings are replaced through one labels value. The value is a Float, as Material 3 progress is.
accessibility: The badge is one TalkBack element read as "Needs check, 42% confidence", then the explanation.
The bar group is a progress bar with the content description "Confidence", the value text as its state description and the progress range; the explanation is a separate text after it.
The band is always in words; the icon is optional and the color is never the only signal.
The percentage is formatted in the configuration locale.
Not interactive. Text grows with the font size setting and the bar header wraps.
The bar fill animates with the theme motion and changes at once when animations are off; it starts at the start edge and mirrors in right-to-left layouts.
edgeCases: A value exactly on the low threshold is medium; exactly on the high threshold is high.
If lowThreshold is above highThreshold there is no medium band.

examples.title: Badges
A bar with the reason

MonarchAiConfidenceMeter(
    value = 0.91f,
    variant = MonarchAiConfidenceMeterVariant.Bar,
